items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: Well, they was playing with the Armored Band, Brass Band. ... Excelsior Band, Olympia Band, Imperial Band.

ctx.x: You ever heard of him? Never, I've heard of him, but never knew much about him. You know anything about him, especially? No, he's a fine drummer. What part of town he came from?
